gameCompatibility.manualSmokeTestScope: Solo and multiplayer reported working for both mods. Detailed rank, interaction, latency and save/resume coverage is not exhaustive.

changes: Chalk uses genuine normal-throw coroutine provenance, including flails
Fresh Meat retains its formula; confirmed-hit cue and bounded condition logs added

knownEvidence: Checkpoint network serialization omits playerName and normalizes previousArena.
Generic feature resets can erase an in-progress checkpoint agreement.
PlayerCount is not a safe spawned-player readiness check.
